name: IC Logic — 10V — SOT
description: Logic IC cluster of two 10V parts in SOT packaging featuring Darlington and pre-biased NPN+PNP transistors with SMD and through-hole mounting options.
selection_hints: Select when needing 10V logic components in SOT packaging.
Choose between single-channel Darlington (BSP52T3G) and pre-biased NPN+PNP (MUN5330DW1T1G) configurations.
Verify matching SOT-223-3 or SOT-363 footprint dimensions.
avoid_when: Avoid if the application requires operational ratings outside 10V.
Do not use if footprints other than SOT-223-3 or SOT-363 are required.
Avoid when tier A parts or non-SOT package families are required.
